ma.canIUse(string schema)

Check whether Mini Programs' APIs, callbacks, parameters, and components are available in the current version.

Parameter

string schema

Use ${API}.${method}.${param}.${option} or ${component}.${attribute}.${option} to call.

Return Value

boolean

Whether the current version is available.

Parameter Description

${API} indicates the API name.

${method} indicates the call method. The valid values are return, success, object, and callback.

${param} indicates a parameter or return value.

${option} indicates the optional value or return value of a parameter.

${component} indicates the component name.

${attribute} indicates component attributes.

${option} indicates the optional values of the component attributes.

Sample Code

// Attribute or method of an object.
ma.canIUse('Image.src');

// Macle API parameter, callback, or return value.
ma.canIUse('openBluetoothAdapter');
ma.canIUse('getSystemInfo.success.screenWidth');
ma.canIUse('showToast.object.image');
ma.canIUse('request.object.method.GET');

// Component attributes.
ma.canIUse('scroll-view');
ma.canIUse('button.size');
ma.canIUse('button.type.default');
